notes.title: Game Update: Bug Fixes Are Here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, gamers! 🎮

We’ve dropped a new update to fix some annoying issues. Here’s what’s new:

[*]🔧 Fixed the bug that stopped some players from progressing past Day 9.
[*]💡 Took care of a bunch of minor bugs to make your gameplay smoother than ever.

Big thanks for all your feedback and patience! Keep sharing your thoughts—it’s because of you the game keeps getting better 💜.

Play, explore, and enjoy! 🚀

With love,
Pocket Rocket Studio 🚀[/h3]

notes.title: Spice Up Your Profile: New Steam Items for My Sexy Neighbor!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, neighbors! 👋

We’ve got some exciting news for you! New Steam community items are now available for My Sexy Neighbor! Collect spicy trading cards, decorate your profile with sizzling backgrounds, and unlock playful emoticons and stylish avatar frames to show off your love for the game.

Dive back into the fun, explore all the neighborly surprises, and start earning these hot rewards. Thanks for being part of our amazing community! 💋

Best regards,
Pocket Rocket Studio 🚀 Team[/h3]
